units.text: EXT. WHALE-RIB BRIDGE TOLLHOUSE - DUSK
A bridge arches across a canyon of drifting violet fog.
Its span is made of the ribs of some ancient leviathan, bleached bone-white and lashed together with silver rope.
At its near end stands a crooked tollhouse of driftwood and green glass, a single lantern burning in its window.
BRYNMOR ASHDOWN (60s, weathered, long grey coat, a ring of keys at his belt) sits on the tollhouse step, whittling.
A kettle hisses on a tiny stove at his feet.
The fog below breathes in and out like a sleeping animal.
Far down the bridge, a figure appears, a shape resolving from the mist, leaning on a staff.
TALLIS WREN (30s, pilgrim's cloak, boots patched with cloth) walks slowly, the bone ringing softly under each step.
He reaches the step and stops.
He does not look at Brynmor's face.
Is this the toll?
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: It is a toll.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: What does he ask?
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: A true thing. Not a large one.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: Tallis lowers his hood.
His beard is young, his eyes tired.
He considers.
I am afraid I will not finish.
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: Finish what?
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: Anything.
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: Brynmor puts down the knife.
He pours tea into two tin cups, his hands slow and steady, and hands one up.
That will do.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: It was not much.
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: It was true. He is not greedy.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: Tallis takes the cup.
The steam drifts between them.
Behind them the fog sighs, and one of the ribs hums a long, low note in the rising wind.
How many cross?
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: Fewer than cross back.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: Tallis drinks.
His eyes close.
When he opens them, the lantern has brightened, and the far end of the bridge, which was dark, shows one small light.
Go on. He is waiting. He is not so fierce.
units.name: BRYNMOR

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: TALLIS

units.text: Mind the fourth rib. It sings when it is lonely.
units.name: BRYNMOR
